sonnet.problem: The joke blends its everyday comparison (a boss calling your name across the office) with the Bible setting ('a thousand nobles are listening'). The text never says the thousand nobles listen to this exchange, so the line also adds a detail the text doesn't give.
sonnet.rule: One image only. Never blend the comparison with the Bible setting.

sonnet.rule: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are.
